text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a scrimmage on today, so I head
over to
take a look.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle is among the runners who are
warming
up. She looks especially
focused.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment the race begins, she hurtles
toward
the front to take the lead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her feet pound at the turf, she only
seems to
get faster with each step. In the
end, she
maintains her lead all the way
to first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, after the scrimmage is over, I drop
by the
track again. It's there I see...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Just... a little... more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle's running laps on her own. Is
she still
training even after running a
race?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew... All right, time to go agai—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um... is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The speed she used to charge her way to
first
place was astonishing, but a
performance like
that must have been
straining on the body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've had my concerns about K.S.Miracle
before,
but I worry if she's getting
enough rest to
counterbalance her
strenuous training...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oh. You saw the race?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. And I appreciate your concern,
too.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. I can still keep going.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you're worried, why not stay and
watch? I run
better when people are
watching me, you know.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trust me, once you see me in action, all
your
worries will be put to rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her nimble footsteps steadily pick up,
like a
crescendo of speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's when it happens.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She accelerates dramatically yet again.
Her thin
frame seems to slice through
the air like a honed
knife.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no hesitation in her movements.
Every
stride she takes devours the turf
beneath her. The
way she runs—it almost
looks like she's burning
her life force
away.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... See? I'm perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what to say, but I can't stop
thinking
about that razor-sharp running
of hers.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: "How"?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, I was never
supposed to
make it this far.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My body used to be very weak. And I've
had more
than one brush with death.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...But each time, everyone came
together for me
and made a miracle
happen.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The support they gave me was my
salvation. It's
thanks to them that I can
run today.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's my turn to pull off a
miracle—using the
very same legs they
gave me the chance to run
on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her voice is firm, steady with the
strength of her
determination. But even
after watching her run, I
can't help but
be concerned.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So what did you think of my running? I'm
fast,
aren't I?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haha. See? I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: My... mind?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That's one way to look at things.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But I'll be all right. I know my goal, and I
won't
waver from it—not now, not ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her sheer conviction must be what
propels her
forward at full tilt. Whether
that's really what's
best for her, though,
is an entirely different
question.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sure. But as I just showed you, my body's

perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to worry about. I won't
trouble
you or anyone else.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me. The sun's strong
today, so
make sure to keep hydrated,
okay?
...I'll see you around.
